The geometric_depth_auditor's depth map shows a continuous surface between the arm and the yellow blob, confirming fusion rather than distinct objects. The topology_boundary_auditor's mask (showing the arm and the fused yellow blob as one contiguous white region) further confirms this topological error. The perceptual_quality_auditor missed these structural issues because it only looks for graphics-level distortions (noise/blur), which is a known blind spot. The background blur is likely an AI artifact (uniform smearing) rather than optical bokeh, as noted by the Router.
